title: Jawahar Mohra (Sada)
description: Jawahar Mohra is a prestigious compound consisting of purified precious stones and minerals processed in rose water, creating a unique formulation with exceptional therapeutic properties. This classical preparation acts as an exceptional exhilarant and protector for the brain and heart, supporting optimal function of these vital organs. The formulation checks fainting episodes by improving cardiovascular function and cerebral blood flow. Nervous breakdown and severe stress-induced conditions respond to this tablet's deep nourishing and stabilizing action. High stress and anxiety find relief through the calming mineral essence of this formulation. The use of precious stone minerals connects this tablet to Ayurveda's mineral pharmacy traditions.
dosage: 1 pill daily mixed with honey or cream
